question: Which genes have a validated unfavourable prognosis in liver hepatocellular carcinoma (TCGA) in the Human Protein Atlas and are also classified as tissue enriched in liver at the RNA level?

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Gene\", \"Gene name\", \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS v FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE lower(\"Cancer\") LIKE '%liver hepatocellular carcinoma%' AND lower(\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\") IN ('yes','true','1') ORDER BY \"Gene\""}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"RNA tissue specificity\", \"RNA tissue distribution\", COUNT(*) AS n FROM proteinatlas GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 100"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Cancer\", \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS v, COUNT(*) AS n FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE lower(\"Cancer\") LIKE '%liver%' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT c.\"Gene\", c.\"Gene name\", c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS p, p.\"RNA tissue specificity\" AS spec, p.\"RNA tissue distribution\" AS dist, t.\"Tissue\", t.\"nTPM\" FROM cancer_prognostic_data c JOIN proteinatlas p ON c.\"Gene\"=p.\"Gene\" JOIN rna_tissue_consensus t ON c.\"Gene\"=t.\"Gene\" WHERE c.\"Cancer\"='Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA)' AND c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" IS NOT NULL AND c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" <> '' AND p.\"RNA tissue specificity\"='Tissue enriched' AND lower(t.\"Tissue\")='liver' ORDER BY c.\"Gene\""}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Gene\", \"Gene name\", \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE \"Cancer\"='Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA)' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS DOUBLE) NULLS LAST LIMIT 10"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT c.\"Gene\", c.\"Gene name\", c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS p, p.\"RNA tissue specificity\" AS spec, p.\"RNA tissue distribution\" AS dist FROM cancer_prognostic_data c JOIN proteinatlas p ON c.\"Gene\"=p.\"Ensembl\" WHERE c.\"Cancer\"='Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA)' AND c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" <> '' AND p.\"RNA tissue specificity\"='Tissue enriched' ORDER BY c.\"Gene\""}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT * FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE lower(\"Tissue\") LIKE '%liver%' LIMIT 5"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT c.\"Gene\", c.\"Gene name\", c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS p, pa.\"RNA tissue specificity\" AS spec, t.\"nTPM\" AS liver_nTPM FROM cancer_prognostic_data c JOIN proteinatlas pa ON c.\"Gene\"=pa.\"Ensembl\" JOIN rna_tissue_consensus t ON c.\"Gene\"=t.\"Gene\" WHERE c.\"Cancer\"='Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA)' AND c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" <> '' AND pa.\"RNA tissue specificity\"='Tissue enriched' AND t.\"Tissue\"='liver' ORDER BY c.\"Gene\""}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH x AS (SELECT c.\"Gene\", c.\"Gene name\", c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS p, t.\"Tissue\", TRY_CAST(t.\"nTPM\" AS DOUBLE) AS n FROM cancer_prognostic_data c JOIN proteinatlas pa ON c.\"Gene\"=pa.\"Ensembl\" JOIN rna_tissue_consensus t ON c.\"Gene\"=t.\"Gene\" WHERE c.\"Cancer\"='Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA)' AND c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" <> '' AND pa.\"RNA tissue specificity\"='Tissue enriched') SELECT \"Gene\", \"Gene name\", p, MAX(CASE WHEN Tissue='liver' THEN n ELSE NULL END) AS liver_nTPM, MAX(n) AS max_nTPM, FIRST(Tissue ORDER BY n DESC) AS top_tissue FROM x GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING FIRST(Tissue ORDER BY n DESC)='liver' ORDER BY \"Gene\""}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH x AS (SELECT c.\"Gene\", c.\"Gene name\", c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" p, t.\"Tissue\", TRY_CAST(t.\"nTPM\" AS DOUBLE) n FROM cancer_prognostic_data c JOIN proteinatlas pa ON c.\"Gene\"=pa.\"Ensembl\" JOIN rna_tissue_consensus t ON c.\"Gene\"=t.\"Gene\" WHERE c.\"Cancer\"='Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA)' AND c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" <> '' AND pa.\"RNA tissue specificity\"='Tissue enriched') SELECT * FROM x QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY \"Gene\" ORDER BY n DESC)=1 ORDER BY \"Gene\""}

turns.text:
No genes meet both criteria in the available Human Protein Atlas data.

The TCGA liver hepatocellular carcinoma genes marked **“validated prognostic – unfavorable”** that are **RNA tissue enriched** are enriched in tissues other than liver (for example, **TFF2** in stomach, **FABP6** in small intestine, and **GUCY2C** in duodenum). None has liver as its highest-expression tissue in the HPA RNA tissue-consensus data.
